name: encoding_detect
description: Detect the text encoding of bytes given as hex and convert them to UTF-8: byte-order marks (UTF-8, UTF-16, UTF-32), strict UTF-8 validation, UTF-16 and UTF-32 without a BOM from the pattern of NUL bytes, ISO-2022-JP escapes, and the single-byte Western encodings cp1252, latin-1, ISO-8859-15, cp850 and mac_roman ranked by how plausible their decoded characters are, with a confidence, the equivalent encodings and the decoded text. Standard library only; charset_normalizer would be the tier-2 alternative.

path.description: Or a relative path to the file

encoding.description: Skip detection and decode with this codec

candidates.description: Single-byte encodings to rank (default cp1252, latin-1, iso-8859-15, cp850, mac_roman)

catalog.source: Unicode Standard 15, section 2.6 and table 2-4 (byte-order marks); RFC 3629 (UTF-8); WHATWG Encoding (latin-1 read as windows-1252); plausibility ranking after charset_normalizer's mess detection, simplified
